description: Loose metal characters locked into a holder so that a whole line of lettering can be set and struck across a panel in one operation, much like a pallet. It trades the flexibility of single letters for regularity and speed, useful when many identical copies must be lettered.
name: type

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
